headlines.title: Trump eases Russia sanctions, says Putin will release diesel as prices spike
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin would “immediately” release hundreds of thousands of tons of diesel fuel onto the global market.

headlines.title: Elon Musk’s growing SpaceX empire sends AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile shares plunging
headlines.description: Elon Musk’s plan for SpaceX to become a major mobile carrier sent shares of AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile plunging and wiped out over $50 billion before lunch.

headlines.title: Gas cost calculator: How much have higher gas prices cost you?
headlines.description: Americans have spent an estimated $40 billion more in gas since the Iran war started. According to an NBC News analysis, drivers who fill up twice a month paid anywhere from $20 to $300 more for gas.

headlines.title: Map: How much you pay in federal and state gas taxes
headlines.description: As national gas price averages head toward $5 per gallon, one state has already suspended its gas tax, and now President Donald Trump and his Cabinet are talking about doing the same.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Holiday Budget Tips to Make Sure You Don't Overspend
headlines.description: With the holiday season looming, the most wonderful time of the year can quickly become the most expensive and stressful time of the year. Finance expert and author Jean Chatzky joins TODAY with ways to save on gifts, travel, and more.

headlines.title: How to Save as Temperatures Drop and Heating Costs Rise
headlines.description: Whether you use oil or electricity to heat your home, you may notice a higher heating bill this year. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY with tips on how to prepare your home, ways to keep costs down and resources for financial assistance.

headlines.title: Carhartt CEO weighs in on retail affordability
headlines.description: The demand for skilled trade workers such as electricians, carpenters, and mechanics is expected to accelerate in the next decade and Carhartt, which has long been a staple for those doing these jobs, is seeing changes in the retail landscape. NBC News' Christine Romans spoke with Carhartt CEO Linda Hubbard about what the company is seeing as affordability remains top of mind for Americans.

headlines.title: Financial Tips to Support Your Kids and Your Aging Parents
headlines.description: The sandwich generation is that expensive time when you’re raising kids and helping out aging parents. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY with tips to navigate that financial situation and resources that can help.

headlines.title: For the same ticket on StubHub, different prices for different people
headlines.description: NBC News volunteers saw eight different prices for the exact same Harry Styles ticket on StubHub. The company said it’s running random price experiments.

headlines.title: Trump establishes panel to probe Fed governor Lisa Cook in latest attempt to fire her
headlines.description: President Donald Trump established a committee to investigate Fed governor Lisa Cook, in his latest attempt to fire her.

headlines.title: Food pantries overwhelmed by Trump cuts
headlines.description: Those on the front lines of feeding their neighbors in rural West Virginia say they face unprecedented challenges brought on by Washington.
